name: Low jack

phases.name: out
phases.cue: Stay low — jump your feet out wide

phases.name: wide
phases.cue: Land softly, knees out over your toes

phases.name: in
phases.cue: Jump your feet back in, hips still low

phases.name: together
phases.cue: Chest up, hands together in front

formTips: Sink into a half squat and stay at that height the whole time
Jump your feet out to wider than your shoulders and back in under your hips
Land softly on the balls of your feet, knees in line with your toes
Keep your chest up and your hands together in front of it
commonMistakes: Standing up between jumps instead of staying low
Knees caving in as you land wide
Rounding the back or letting the chest drop
